jobs.title: Founding Product Manager (Y Combinator Startup)
jobs.description:
Wir sind CoCrafter (YC W24) , ein schnell wachsendes Münchner Startup mit der Mission, Kernprozesse der Bauindustrie grundlegend zu ändern.

 Die Bauwirtschaft ist das Rückgrat der deutschen und europäischen Wirtschaft – und dennoch wurde sie von der Digitalisierung weitgehend übersehen. Das Ergebnis? Ineffiziente Prozesse und viel ungenutztes Potenzial. 

 CoCrafter baut das Operating System (OS) für Subcontractor Management und zählt deutschlandweit bereits zahlreiche mittelständische Bau- und Handwerksbetriebe zu seinen Kunden.

 Wir sind mit 1.8m€ von Y Combinator, 10x Founders und weiteren Top-Investoren finanziert – und sind damit bereit für den nächsten großen Wachstumsschritt.

 Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Bauindustrie! 🚀 

 Aufgaben

 Wir suchen Dich für als unseren ersten Product Manager #1 – Du solltest schnell lernen können und den Herausforderungen eines Startups gewachsen sein. Du planst und entwickelst aus Kundengesprächen ein Produkt, das unsere Kunden voranbringt. Du wirst eigene Features end-to-end denken, designen und entwickeln, und dabei eng mit unserem Tech-Team zusammenarbeiten. Du bist in CoCrafters kreativstem Team und viel in Anwendungsgesprächen mit unseren Usern, konzeptueller Umsetzung und UX/Design in Berührung. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Co-Founder und CPO Philipp zusammen.

 Verantwortlichkeiten 

 
 Product Ownership**:** Du bekommst eine end-to-end Verantwortlichkeit für eigene Product-Streams.

 Customer Discovery: Direkter Kundenkontakt im Zusammenspiel mit unserem Customer Success. Du wirst eigene Kunden auch in der Implementierung von Features leaden.

 Project Management: Da einige Features von uns sehr komplex sind, ist ein gutes Projektmanagement unabdingbar.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Idealerweise praktische Erfahrungen im Product Management.

 Gutes technisches Verständnis (Software Engineering ist aber nicht notwendig).

 Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse oder Erfahrung in der Handwerks- und/oder Baubranche.

 Proaktive Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, eigenständig Initiative zu ergreifen.

 Freude an der Arbeit in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Umfeld.

 Fließende Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachenniveau (oder vergleichbar).

 Start: Ab sofort.

 
 Benefits

 🦸‍♀️ Ein erstklassiges Netzwerk aus Gründern, Investoren und Mentoren für deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung

 💸 Attraktive Vergütung inklusive Unternehmensanteilen (ESOP) – Du profitierst von unserem Erfolg

 🏖️ 28 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr für Deine Erholung

 🏋️‍♂️ Fitness-Zuschuss , damit Du Dich auch außerhalb des Büros auspowern oder entspannen kannst 😉

 ⛰️ Team-Events wie Bowling, Minigolf, Offsites und regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions

 ☕️ Ein wunderschönes Büro im Herzen Münchens (Maxvorstadt)

 🚀 Warum du Teil von CoCrafter werden solltest 🚀 

 🔥 Impact: In weniger als einem Jahr haben wir ein Produkt geschaffen, das essentiell für unsere Kunden ist. Mit Deiner Arbeit wirst Du eine gesamte Branche neu definieren!

 📈 Wachstum: Der Einstieg in ein Start-up in der frühen Phase ist eine einmalige Gelegenheit. Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden Teams und übernimm eine Schlüsselrolle in dieser Entwicklung!

 🤝 Team: Wir sind ein interdisziplinäres, dynamisches und unterstützendes Team , das mit Leidenschaft etwas Außergewöhnliches aufbaut. Werde Teil von CoCrafter und entwickle Dich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich weiter!

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
 Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
 Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
 Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
 Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 Du wertest Kundenfeedback systematisch aus (Surveys, Reviews, Retourengründe) und bringst die Erkenntnisse ins Produktteam und in die Kampagnen
 Du konzipierst Angebote und Bundles mit und rechnest sie durch – auf Deckungsbeitrag, nicht nur auf Conversion
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 

 Dein Profil 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Product Marketing, Brand Management oder Growth – idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand oder im E-Commerce
 Du hast schon Produktlaunches verantwortet und kannst konkret sagen, was dabei rausgekommen ist
 Du schreibst selbst: Positionierungen, Briefings, Landingpage-Copy. Klar und ohne Floskeln
 Du arbeitest mit Zahlen: Conversion, Deckungsbeitrag, Sell-Through sagen dir etwas
 Du verstehst, wie Performance-Creative funktioniert und was ein Hook ist 
 Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Maximaler Einfluss: Product Marketing sitzt bei uns direkt an der Schnittstelle von Produkt, Growth und Founder-Team. Deine Erkenntnisse beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche Produkte wir als Nächstes entwickeln.
 Keine Marketing-Theorie: Du arbeitest mit echten Kunden, echten Kaufdaten und sehr großen Mengen an Performance- und Creative-Daten und siehst unmittelbar, welche Entscheidungen funktionieren.
 Extrem schnelle Feedback-Loops: Produkt, Performance Marketing, Creative, CRM und E-Commerce arbeiten eng zusammen. Was du entwickelst, landet nicht Monate später in einer Präsentation, sondern wird getestet.
 Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du übernimmst keine fertige Product-Marketing-Struktur, sondern kannst Prozesse, Customer-Insights-Systeme und Launch-Mechaniken selbst aufbauen und prägen.
 Große Reichweite: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst Produkte und Kampagnen für eine Brand mit bereits über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden.
 Direkter Austausch mit den Foundern: Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Geschwindigkeit und direkter Zugang zu den Personen, die Produkt- und Unternehmensstrategie verantworten.
 Starkes Performance-Marketing-Umfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit einem datengetriebenen Performance- und Creative-Team zusammen und kannst Produktmarketing unmittelbar mit realem Marktfeedback verbinden.
 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir wollen nicht, dass du bestehende Prozesse nur ausführst. Wir erwarten, dass du sie hinterfragst und besser machst.
 Steile Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Pammys wächst weiter in neue Produkte, Kategorien und Märkte. Dein Verantwortungsbereich kann mit diesem Wachstum deutlich größer werden.
 Unternehmerische Kultur: Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Entscheidungen treffen und Ergebnisse liefern wollen.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Wir machen wenige Modelle in großen Stückzahlen — jeder Millimeter am Leisten, im Fußbett und in der Konstruktion multipliziert sich hunderttausendfach. Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht.
 Du baust dein Team auf und führst es: Footwear Development, Leisten & Passform (Last & Fit), Tooling, Commercialisation und Materials — in der Reihenfolge, die das Wachstum verlangt.
 Du etablierst Leisten und Passform als Kernkompetenz: eigene Leisten-Bibliothek, Passform-Standards, Grading — bei Comfort-Schuhen ist der Leisten das Produkt.
 Du entwickelst unsere eigenen Komfort-Technologien für Fußbett und Sohle — gemeinsam mit starken Material- und Compound-Partnern.
 Du verankerst Wear-Tests sowie Prüf- und Compliance-Standards (SATRA/ISO, REACH, Produktsicherheit für den EU-Markt) im Entwicklungsprozess.
 Du arbeitest im festen Dreier-Team mit Produktmanagement und Design: Du machst Entwürfe baubar, ohne sie kleinzumachen.
 Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sourcing ab — zu Machbarkeit, Werkzeugen und Serienanlauf.
 

 Dein Profil Langjährige Erfahrung in der Footwear-Produktentwicklung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre), davon mehrere Jahre fabrikseitig in Asien — im Sample Room, nicht nur im Videocall.
 Ideal: Erfahrung mit Comfort-Produkten oder EVA (Spritzguss, Formteile) — alternativ Athletic Footwear mit echter Tooling-Tiefe.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (All gender)
jobs.description:
About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. 

 Drive Execution:  Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. 

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. 

 

 Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. 

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. 
 

 We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.

 Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
 Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
 Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
 Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
 Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
 Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
 Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
 Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
 Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
 Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
 Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.
 

 We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
 You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
 You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
 You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
 You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
 You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
 You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
 You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
 You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.

 Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
 Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)

Your Mission This is a company built for growth. 
 When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.  
 We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling. 
 As  Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

 Discovery, scoping & prioritization  You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately. 

 Agile ownership & delivery  You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.

 High-scale product teams  At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Local Payments (Portuguese + Spanish)
jobs.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.

 
 

 

 The Purpose: 
 

 
 As a Product Manager in PPRO’s Local Payments Domain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the payment experiences for our customers and partners, ensuring seamless, compliant, and efficient access to local payment methods. You will drive product discovery and delivery, working at the intersection of Engineering, Marketing, Risk, and Commercial teams to enable seamless adoption of local payment methods to some of the world’s leading fintechs, PSPs, and merchants. 

 Product Managers at PPRO have the passion and abilities for ensuring that we focus our time and energy on building the right things for our customers. You will inform the strategy, communicate with all relevant stakeholders and lead effective product discoveries with your team. Our mission is to make local payment methods as ubiquitous and accessible as credit cards. You will own and develop a portfolio of Local Payments integrations, engaging with schemes, defining a strong value proposition, and validating and setting success metrics. 

 In this impactful and highly visible role, you will own key business opportunities and product initiatives related to the portfolio, orchestrating flows, fine tuning the user experience, and co-creating new features together with the schemes and our customers. Your work will directly impact PPRO’s ability to scale globally by increasing adoption, improving success rates, and driving the commercial and technical integration of high-value local payment products. 

 What You Will Be Doing 
 
 
 
 Execute and inform our product strategy for our local payments portfolio from scheme engagement to product feature development and market launch. 

 
 Drive product discovery and delivery - collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to develop innovative, "Better-than-direct" payment experiences that drive value for our business and customers. 

 
 Develop and optimise the payments product portfolio that balances scheme requirements, financial efficiency, and high success rates for consumers and merchants. 

 
 Work hands-on with data - analyze key business opportunities and success metrics related to payment acceptance rates, scheme performance, and financial flow efficiency to drive meaningful outcomes. 

 
 Define clear success metrics and KPIs to measure payment method efficiency, automate reporting, and enable data-driven decision-making. 

 
 Collaborate cross-functionally – work closely with Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Customer Success teams to refine payment requirements, implement new features, and understand business needs. 

 
 Inform the roadmap planning and lead the execution for key initiatives, such as the strategic integration of new local payment methods, optimization of existing flows, and co-creation of new products with schemes. 

 
 Be a thought leader in local payments – stay ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and best practices to keep PPRO at the forefront of effective, efficient, and accessible payments across the world. 

 

 What Success Looks Like 
 
 
 
 Improved adoption and financial performance of the local payments portfolio through optimization and strategic feature releases. 

 
 Higher payment success rates and fewer manual interventions for payment flows. 

 
 Seamless integration and expansion of new local payment methods and features into the core PPRO platform, replacing legacy integration methods. 

 
 Clear, data-driven insights into payment performance (acceptance rates, authorization rates, scheme metrics), with real-time visibility for internal stakeholders. 

 
 Positive feedback from customers and partners on the functionality, reliability, and value derived from the local payment methods. 

 

 What We Are Looking For 

 Languages: English + Portuguese + Spanish are a must. 

 
 Product Leadership: Proven experience owning a product or feature set, leading product discovery, and executing successfully in a fast-paced environment. 

 
 Strong Analytical Mindset: Ability to work with data, define KPIs, and drive decisions base

Growth at our pace creates a constant stream of high-stakes, cross-functional initiatives that don't sit neatly inside any one team such as entering new markets, redesigning pricing, launching e-invoicing ahead of regulation.
 This role owns those initiatives. You'll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives (and, through him, the executive committee) to take our most important initiatives from a blank page to a shipped outcome. jobs.title: Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Projekt für Dich: moebel.de ist eines der führenden Online-Shoppingportale für Möbel und Einrichtung in Europa. Unser neues Projekt  Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen.
Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über  100 Millionen Angeboten , vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. 

Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d) .

 Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung.
 Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt.
 Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat.
 Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein.
 Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt.
 Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live. 
 Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung.

 Freelance Product Manager (w/m/d) - Abrechnung & ERP - 3 bis 6 Monate

 Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. 
 
 Das Projekt:

 Die ginisuite ist unsere eigens entwickelte ERP-/PVS-Lösung für Arbeitsmedizin und Arbeitssicherheit. Im Fokus des Projekts steht die fachliche und produktseitige Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter Module in den Bereichen Vertragsmanagement, Abrechnung, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung .

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

 Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

 The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
 GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

 What we´re looking for You have personally written the tickets. 
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
 You are technical enough to argue with engineers. 
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
 You can write. 
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
 You write specs worth acting on. 
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
 You know what looks good. 
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
 You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. 
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
 You want to be coached hard. 
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
 You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. 
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
 You want the scope to grow. 
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

 What you`ll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. 
 Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
 Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
 Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
 Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
 Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients
 
 What you'll be scoping over your first year: 
 Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
 Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
 AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
 Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
 You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.

 Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
 Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
 Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
 Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background
 Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
 Notion fluency
 
 Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.

 How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.
 Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
 Interview with the PM, including a brief intro

jobs.title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
jobs.description:
About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. 

 Hybrid by design:  
 We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Full Remote - Europe)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products
 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 
 One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 
 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 
 
 At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.
 Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .
 And we’re only just getting started! 
 
 Our Team
 We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.
 
 Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]
 • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 
 • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 
 • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 
 
 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]
 • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 
 
 Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]
 • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 
 
 Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]
 • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 
 • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 
 • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 
 • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 
 
 Your Role
 Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.
 This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.
 You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.
 At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.
 If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role. 
  
 Your Responsibilities
 Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

 Build with AI every day: Use AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and debugging; as a genuine part of how you think and work, evolving with the tools as they improve;

 Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

 Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

 Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

 Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

  
 Your Qualifications
 You build with AI: you’ve personally built and shipped a functional feature, experiment, prototype, workflow, or tool using AI coding tools. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools are already part of how you work everyday;

 You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

 You explore AI independently: you actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

 You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fix

jobs.description:
Intro Adsquare's mission is centered on: 
 Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data. 

 Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers. 

 
 
 Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them: 
 Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes. 

 Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges. 

 No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication. 

 Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves. 

 Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect. 

 

 About the team You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy. 

 Your Mission As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted. 

 Your Profile 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem. 

 Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams. 

 Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog. 

 Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation. 

 Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering. 

 A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic. 

 A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs. 

 A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly. 

 

 What you will do Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories. 

 Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads. 

 Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products. 

 Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements. 

 Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts. 

 Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery.

Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

 As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

 As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
 You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
 You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
 You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
 You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
 You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.

 Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
 Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
 Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. 
 Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. 
 Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. 
 Business fluency in both  English and German  is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.

jobs.description:
About Fyxer
 Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.
 
 The Mission
 At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution .
  
 We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who uses research, data, and experimentation to drive better bets, faster learning, and stronger commercial outcomes. We’re not looking for someone to write specs and hand over insights. We want someone who helps us think better and decide better.
 You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain alongside our product, growth and leadership teams.
 
 
The Role 
 You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain / category design alongside our product / growth and leadership teams. 
 You will operate at speed. We care about generating signals quickly, making informed decisions, and learning fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening thinking as you go.
 You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes and a fullstack background around A/B experimentation and everything that comes with it.
  
  
 What you will own:
 You will own the quality of our product bets and the speed at which we learn.
 Turn ambiguity into direction. Take messy signals from customers, product data, and the market and translate them into clear problem framing and product strategy.

 Work directly with engineers. You will partner closely with engineers and founders from the start of an initiative, shaping solutions together rather than handing over specs.

 Use the right tools to validate ideas and reduce risk: interviews, prototypes, experiments, product analytics, fake doors, usability testing, and behavioural analysis

 Ship, learn, and iterate quickly. Move product bets from idea to shipped product to measurable outcomes, continuously tightening the loop between learning and building.

 Raise the bar of product thinking across the team by coaching others, introducing scalable frameworks, and helping the team stay close to customers

  
  
 Who You Are 
 Expert: You are an expert in your domain specialization that everyone could learn from including our other PM’s

 Systems thinker: You understand customer journeys, funnels, and feedback loops. You connect user behaviour to outcomes and revenue impact, not just isolated features.

 Engineering partner : You work closely with engineers and founders, translating user insight into clear problem framing and practical tradeoffs. You influence what we build through evidence and clarity.

 Decision oriented : You know when there is enough signal to move. You help others clarify thinking, sharpen hypotheses, and make confident calls under uncertainty.

 Capability builder: You design product systems that compound over time rather than one off projects. Your work levels up how we do product and discovery across the company, and you introduce frameworks, coach others, and build repeatable learning loops.

  
 Why Fyxer? 
 We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.
 Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

 Scope: This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.. 

 Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  
 Compensation: £140K – £180K • £140K – £180K Equity

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?
 Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
 Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.
 
 Notre vision 
 Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.
 Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.
 Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.
 
 À propos de Pennylane 
 Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.
 
 En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

 Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour toi? 
 Tu as envie de comprendre aussi bien l’aspect technique que le business sales. Tu souhaite réfléchir à la configuration et aux solutions avec les devs ET parler efficacité commerciale avec les sales managers.
 
 Le contexte 
 Ce poste fait partie de Sales Strategy & Operations, l'équipe centrale qui pilote toute la stratégie revenue de Pennylane. C'est une équipe de 10 personnes, et tu participeras au succès et de la scalabilité de notre machine commerciale.
 
 Le poste 
 L’objectif est de devenir une source d’informations et solutions pour l’équipe Sales, les débloquer, et les rendre toujours plus efficaces.
 Pour cela, tu vas aider à comprendre leurs contraintes, prioriser, et piloter les projets qui impactent vraiment leur productivité (configurations Salesforce, intégrations outils, optimisations, IA...).
 Avec une forte dimension apprentissage et projet, tu vas monter progressivement en expertise sur notre stack (Salesforce, Modjo, ChiliPiper, Ringover, Dust...) et devenir clé pour que l'équipe Sales scale efficacement.

 Piloter les projets - De la spécification à la mise en production : cadrer, planifier, coordonner avec l'équipe tech, tester, communiquer, et accompagner la conduite du changement

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?
 Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?
 Then Pennylane is the right place for you !
  
 Our vision 
 We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
 We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
  
 About us 
 Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)
  
 In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :
 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...
 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor .
 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe
 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 
 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!
  
  
 Why this role exists 
 Pennylane is one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. Growth at our pace creates a constant stream of high-stakes, cross-functional initiatives that don't sit neatly inside any one team such as entering new markets, redesigning pricing, launching e-invoicing ahead of regulation.
 This role owns those initiatives. You'll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives (and, through him, the executive committee) to take our most important initiatives from a blank page to a shipped outcome. It's a rare seat: broad exposure to how a scale-up actually makes its biggest decisions, real ownership from day one, and the kind of scope that builds a strong foundation for an operating role over time.
 
 What you'll own 
 You'll lead selected priority initiatives end-to-end. For each, that means:
 Framing the problem. Turn an ambiguous executive ambition into a structured plan: the hypothesis, the analysis that tests it, the milestones, and the definition of success.

 Driving the work. Coordinate the product, commercial, finance, and ops teams needed to deliver. You're the person who makes sure it actually ships, on time and to the bar.

 Doing the analysis yourself. Build the models, pull the data, and pressure-test the numbers that decisions rest on. You won't delegate the thinking.

 Keeping the ExCo close. Report progress, risks, and recommendations crisply and often. When something is off track, they hear it from you first, with a proposed path forward.

 Some initiatives you'll run start to finish. On others you'll be the extra set of hands on whatever matters most that quarter. Both require someone who's comfortable being handed a hard, undefined problem and trusted to figure it out.
 
 Who we're looking for 
 5–10 years in top-tier management consulting and/or a VC-backed scale-up, with a track record of owning complex projects to completion in a fast-moving environment.

 Exceptional analytical capabilities — you're fluent with data and models, and you use them to sharpen decisions, not decorate them.

 Structured thinker and clear communicator who can make a complex trade-off legible to an executive audience in a page or a slide.

 Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity: strong judgment, a bias to action, and the maturity to prioritize hard.

 Fluent in French and English.

 This is a role for a strategic thinker who likes to get their hands dirty. If that's you, we'd love to talk.
 Recruitment process 
 Screening with Orane, Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

 Interview with Eric, VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)

 Take-home business case, presented live (1h)

 Final interview with a founder (45 min)

  
 What do we do to make your work life easier 
  
 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane
 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package
 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us
 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it
 ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

 Understanding of maritime operations and sensor integration. 

 Ability to lead cross-functional teams and navigate regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.
 For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.
 Angi at a glance: 
 Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

 Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

 Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

 About the Team 
 Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.
 The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.
 This role stewards that platform's product direction.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Product Management 
 Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.

 Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.

 Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.

 Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.

 Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.

 Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.

 Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

 
 Execution and Individual Contribution 
 Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.

 Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.

 Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.

 Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy.

 
 Who You Are 
 Five or more years of product management experience on a data or infrastructure platform team, where you stewarded technical roadmaps directly.

 Comfortable reading system architecture and pipeline dependencies well enough to make real sequencing calls with engineering.

 A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan.

 Transparent about areas of growth and open to learning, rather than presenting incomplete information as fully resolved under pressure.

 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience weighing compute cost against performance and developer experience, and driving that tradeoff to a decision rather than just planning around it.

 Working knowledge of how AI agents consume data and tools differently from people, and judgment on when a vendor's own agent layer already covers a need.

 A proactive approach to navigating and understanding new technical systems, key contacts, and open questions independently.

 
 Compensation & Benefits 
 The salary band for this position ranges from £90,000 - 120,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

 Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance.

 Temporary work from abroad policy.

 Regular team and social events.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner - Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Yepoda 
 Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations , from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.
 Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™ , we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.
  
 We are looking for a Senior Data & Analytics Product Owner to join our growing Data team at Yepoda. In this role, you will partner closely with our Head of Data & Technology to shape how we build and ship data and analytics products across the business — driving alignment with stakeholders, prototyping ideas hands-on, and making sure our data capabilities translate into real commercial outcomes.
  
 Your Tasks 
 Own the company-wide analytics function, i.e., the KPI framework, reporting cadence, BI tooling/glossary, and our decision-support and reporting standards.

 Own the product delivery roadmap for data initiatives for Yepoda's central Data analytics team.

 Translate commercial questions (CAC/LTV, channel mix, contribution margin, cohort behaviour, inventory turnover, etc.) from Marketing, Operations, Finance and other functions into scoped, prioritized data products and repeatable analyses.

 Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that data engineering and analytics teams can execute against without ambiguity. Be the person who closes the gap between "the business wants something" and "the team knows what to build."

 Lead discovery and drive experimentation with stakeholders for new data capabilities, from self-serve analytics tooling to ML-powered features.
  

 Your Profile 
 3-5 years in a product management or product owner role in BI or Analytics or closely adjacent role at a relevant D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brand.

 Strong business understanding, you think in terms of impact, not just output. Deep understanding of D2C metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, CIR/ROAS, contribution margin, cohort analytics, marketing attribution, etc).

 Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to operate at C-level, translating fuzzy commercial questions into sharp, defensible analyses

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving fast in a startup environment. You create structure rather than waiting for it.

 Excellent written and spoken English.

  
 Nice to Have 
 Exposure to modern data stack concepts (data warehouses, Self-Serve Analytics tools, ML pipelines); you don't need to build them, but knowing the landscape helps.

 Experience writing SQL or working directly with data and AI tools such as Omni and Claude.

  
 What We Offer 
 Dynamic Environment : The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

 Accelerate Your Career : Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

 Inspiring Workspace : Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

 Hybrid Working : We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

 We Value Diversity : We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

 Employee Discounts : You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

 Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.
  

 Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

jobs.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

At Staffbase, we're moving beyond communication into a new frontier: helping millions of frontline and deskless employees not just find information, but actually get things done. The Actions team owns that execution layer - the bridge between employees, Staffbase AI, and the real operational work happening in stores, warehouses, hospitals, and in the field.

Our biggest bet right now is Tasks - the product that lets an enterprise's HQ push operational standards to thousands of locations and see them executed on the ground, driven by a major new partnership. Around it sits a portfolio of agentic actions, forms, and HR workflows that make Staffbase a place where work happens, not just where it's announced.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to seize this moment. This is a 12-month fixed-term role - and we mean that as a feature. It's a rare chance to make an outsized, visible impact on Staffbase's expansion into operational territory, with senior leadership attention and real revenue behind it, without signing up for the long corporate haul. If you're a builder who loves 0-to-1 energy and wants to point it at a concrete, high-stakes problem for a year, this is for you.

You're a commercially-minded generalist, comfortable in ambiguity, fast-moving, and able to hold the whole picture - customer, business case, and build - in your head at once.

What you'll be doing

  • Own Tasks as your primary focus - shaping it from an early build into a solution that scales to thousands of frontline locations, and driving the roadmap and prioritization calls
  • Partner with an operational-retail domain expert and our internal solution designers to turn a complex real-world problem into the right solution on the Staffbase foundation
  • Work directly with flagship enterprise customers - talking eye-to-eye about their operational reality and turning it into product
  • Keep the wider Actions surface healthy - forms, HR actions, and the existing widget/plugin estate - steering maintenance priorities with the Actions Core team rather than owning the backlog yourself
  • Define what success looks like for operational products: adoption by busy frontline workers first, corporate reporting second
  • Bring an AI-native lens throughout - where an intelligent layer genuinely unblocks a worker, and where it's just noise

Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. About BoWatt
 BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.
 
 We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.
 
 We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.
 
 You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.
 
 The role
 As our Founding Product Manager, you will help determine what BoWatt builds, why we build it, and whether it creates meaningful value for customers.
 
 You will work closely across our commercial, customer success and engineering teams, as well as with our customers. You will develop a deep understanding of complex engineering workflows, turn customer problems into clear product opportunities, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
 
 This is a hands-on product role. You will spend time with customers, work through technical and operational detail, write requirements, make trade-offs, test solutions, and help the team ship quickly.
 
 Lead product discovery - translate complex workflows and customer needs into clear product requirements and success criteria

 Develop a deep understanding of how manufacturing and systems-engineering teams work

 Identify and define the highest-value customer problems for BoWatt to solve

 Help own and prioritise the product roadmap

 Balance strategic opportunities, recurring customer needs, commercial importance, and engineering effort

 Drive product initiatives from initial discovery through scoping, development, launch, and iteration

 Give engineers the context and clarity needed to make strong implementation decisions

 Prototype and test potential solutions with customers before and during development

 Work with Customer Success to turn individual customer feedback into scalable product improvements

 Use qualitative feedback and product data to understand adoption and evaluate whether features are working

 Triage product issues and bugs, make clear prioritisation decisions, and coordinate with Engineering

 Improve BoWatt’s processes for discovery, prioritisation, product delivery, launches, and feedback

 Develop deep expertise in BoWatt’s product, customers, and target industries

 
 During your first six months, you will work closely with our engineering team to build the domain and product knowledge required to take ownership of increasingly important product areas.
 
 You
 You are deeply curious about customers and want to understand how their work actually happens
